set.body: ADR 0027 §5. JVM command `sourceIdentity build INPUTS OUTPUT` in pipeline: decode `source-identity-inputs/v1` (edition facts for one media part with picture and audio streams; visual and dialogue mentions with anchors and optional ProperName; presence claims with HumanReviewed receipts; proposals: NamedReference, DeicticReference, hints, each with a producer-guard outcome), construct through the public checked factories, record every refusal with its ReferentError, resolve, write `source-identity-graph/v1` (classes; each dialogue mention's ReferentRelation to every visual class plus hintsBetween; every proposal with guard and resolver outcomes; manifest and input SHA-256s) via temp dir and move. Synthetic fixtures only (rule 14d). Acceptance: suite covers each outcome class; mutants on refusal recording and on the foreign-input check fail named tests; scoped gate green.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3c-1] sourceIdentity build command in pipeline
